title: Prepare core for the GMCP pillar to leave: route susi-gmcp's callers, then delete it
goal: Vision: V-9. Core half of relocating susi-gmcp (23,071 runtime lines) to susi-commercial-apps, whose copy landed and passes on Windows and Linux (commercial T-CORESIZEVAULT-23, a7960a13). Core's direct susi_gmcp users are few (about 21 references: susi-daemon gmcp_bootstrap, discovery_pipeline, ambient, peer_channel_host, server, engine_hooks, adapter_ops; src/cli os_cli, mcp_cli, mission_cli, tracing_subscriber). Route them over plane topics served by the plug host, keep core's GMCP conformance suites (tests/gmcp_requirements) running against the moved code, then stop linking susi-gmcp, delete it and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: Commercial's relocated crates/susi-gmcp (T-CORESIZEVAULT-23) and the plug host; the forwarding patterns of the MCP fallback move (core 0ee89a8c4) and the vault move.

limitations: Design question first (board 2588): GMCP's tool execution is in the scoped chain (session -> mission -> tool), and core plane_bus req keeps tools.* in-process under a ToolScope, so either the scoped chain moves as one unit or GMCP returns tool calls to its caller. Pillar code: Linux pass (SusiCoreSizeVault) before the deletion. Coordinate with GROKCORESIZE1 on daemon files.
